claim_boundary: This is an acute model-level intervention on already trained M2 checkpoints. It tests functional sufficiency under the frozen model and cannot establish how the networks learned, how humans encode evidence, or a human neural mechanism.
The earlier 3/3 acute observation result belongs to a different 38-channel P-L architecture and is rationale only, not evidence about M2.
All twenty M2 networks and all three existing Liu panels are mandatory. No seed, panel, participant, relation, checkpoint, or condition may be selected or replaced from the new outcomes.
No network is trained or adapted. Architecture, eta, modulation, P dynamics, readout, response temperature, support history, query inputs, and choice seeds remain frozen.
One inherited sigma=1/7 is fixed prospectively. There is no dose grid, human fitting, threshold fitting, or result-conditioned continuation.
Historical human intervals and nine-row classifiers are exposed evaluation references. Quantitative interval membership is descriptive only and cannot select sigma, models, outcomes, or promotion.
A sign-restored folded condition is an oracle amplitude-matched control, not a proposed human observation mechanism.

The frozen 18 stable_constructive versus 2 nonconstructive split is an outcome-independent baseline stratification. The two-network stratum is descriptive and cannot support a population interaction claim.
The study reports a distribution of acute responses. It cannot promote a final main model or justify deleting checkpoints, changing M2, or adding observation-noise training.
